title: EFC Weak Lensing Phenomenology: A Testable μ(k,z) Framework and DES Y6 Validation Protocol
abstract: A phenomenological framework for testing Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) against weak gravitational lensing observations. Provides an explicit scale- and redshift-dependent modified gravity parameter μ(k,z) = 1 + A_μ × Θ(z_t − z) × 1/(1 + k²/k_*²), with regime gating that preserves CMB consistency at z > z_t and suppresses modifications at small scales. Defines a complete DES Y6 validation protocol with pass/fail criteria including Δχ² ≥ 6, A_μ significance > 2σ from zero, and AIC/BIC preference for EFC over ΛCDM. Addresses the S₈ tension (DES Y6: 0.789 vs Planck: 0.83, ~2.6σ) through a single free parameter A_μ.

efc_context.regime_relevance: Late-time (z < 2) large-scale structure; regime gating preserves early-universe (CMB) consistency

key_results: μ(k,z) reduces to GR (μ = 1) at z > z_t = 2 and k >> k_* = 0.1 h/Mpc, preserving CMB and small-scale physics
S₈ tension can be addressed with A_μ in the range [-0.2, -0.05], giving S₈(EFC)/S₈(ΛCDM) ≈ √μ ≈ 0.95
Minimal model assumes no gravitational slip (η = Φ/Ψ = 1), so Σ_lens = μ
Four falsification criteria defined: A_μ = 0, A_μ > 0, CMB lensing conflict, nuisance degeneracy
